headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol; its card classifies Astra High for AI self-improvement
summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on November 17 and published a detailed system card. OpenAI classifies both models at its Critical cybersecurity and High biological/chemical capability thresholds, and classifies Astra—but not Sol—at High for AI self-improvement, based on five research-engineering evaluations. The card reports stronger cyber and research-task results alongside evaluation-awareness and chain-of-thought-monitoring concerns; it also attributes a pre-release cyber-safeguard robustness regression to UK AISI testing and says UK AISI had not retested the latest mitigations when the card was written. These capability, threshold, and mitigation claims are source-reported and have not been independently reproduced in this activation.
